name: 年次有給休暇 (annual paid leave)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §39(1)–(3): 10 労働日 after six months’ continuous service with 80% attendance, then 11, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 at 1½–6½ years; 労働基準法施行規則 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023) §24-3: a worker under 30 hours a week on 4 days or fewer (216 days a year or fewer) gets 7/8/9/10/12/13/15 (4 days), 5/6/6/8/9/10/11 (3), 3/4/4/5/6/6/7 (2), 1/2/2/2/3/3/3 (1). §39(7) ただし書 and 施行規則 §24-5 allow the leave to be granted before its 基準日; recorded default (owner rule 2026-09-28, the engine has no half-year anchor): each statutory grant is given six months early — the first on the hire day, each later one on the hire anniversary — so the leave year is the service year, never later or smaller than the statute, and the 80% attendance test never withholds a grant. §115: the right lapses two years after it can first be exercised — the grant year and one carried year (auto_carry_one_year). §39(9) with 施行規則 §25: paid at the ordinary wage for the scheduled hours (the recorded work-rules default; the 平均賃金 or 標準報酬月額 ÷ 30 methods need the rules or an agreement). name: 産前産後休業 (maternity leave)
authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §65(1)–(2): on request, six weeks before the expected birth (14 weeks for a multiple pregnancy); no work for eight weeks after it (after six, on request with a doctor’s clearance). The Act does not make the employer pay: 健康保険法 §102 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) pays 出産手当金, so the day comes off the wage (paid_by FUND). 42 + 56 = 98 calendar days, 98 + 56 = 154 for a multiple birth; a birth later than expected lengthens the prenatal part, which the fixed count does not add.

name: 育児休業 (childcare leave)

name: 出生時育児休業 (産後パパ育休, postnatal childcare leave)

The Act does not make the employer pay: 健康保険法 §102 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) pays 出産手当金, so the day comes off the wage (paid_by FUND). 42 + 56 = 98 calendar days, 98 + 56 = 154 for a multiple birth; a birth later than expected lengthens the prenatal part, which the fixed count does not add.

name: 育児休業 (childcare leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §5(1)–(4): leave for a child under one, in up to two parts, extendable to 1½ and 2 years where §5(3)–(4) apply (§9-6 パパ・ママ育休プラス to 1 year 2 months). The employer need not pay: 雇用保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/349AC0000000116) pays 育児休業給付, so the day comes off the wage (paid_by FUND). The age bounds are dates the engine cannot meter, so the leave is unmetered; HR checks the child’s age.

name: 出生時育児休業 (産後パパ育休, postnatal childcare leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §9-2(1)–(2): up to four weeks (28 days) in up to two parts within eight weeks of the birth. name: 介護休業 (family-care leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §11(1)–(2), §15(1): 93 days for each 対象家族 in a 要介護状態, in up to three parts. name: 介護休暇 (family-care days off)

The Act does not make the employer pay: 健康保険法 §102 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/211AC0000000070) pays 出産手当金, so the day comes off the wage (paid_by FUND). 42 + 56 = 98 calendar days, 98 + 56 = 154 for a multiple birth; a birth later than expected lengthens the prenatal part, which the fixed count does not add.

name: 育児休業 (childcare leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §5(1)–(4): leave for a child under one, in up to two parts, extendable to 1½ and 2 years where §5(3)–(4) apply (§9-6 パパ・ママ育休プラス to 1 year 2 months). The employer need not pay: 雇用保険法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/349AC0000000116) pays 育児休業給付, so the day comes off the wage (paid_by FUND). The age bounds are dates the engine cannot meter, so the leave is unmetered; HR checks the child’s age.

name: 出生時育児休業 (産後パパ育休, postnatal childcare leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §9-2(1)–(2): up to four weeks (28 days) in up to two parts within eight weeks of the birth. Unpaid by the employer; 雇用保険法 pays 出生時育児休業給付金 (paid_by FUND). The eight-week window and the two-part limit are not metered.

name: 介護休業 (family-care leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §11(1)–(2), §15(1): 93 days for each 対象家族 in a 要介護状態, in up to three parts. Unpaid by the employer; 雇用保険法 pays 介護休業給付 (paid_by FUND). One event is one family member’s care; the 93 days are its pool, and the three-part limit across entries is not metered.

name: 介護休暇 (family-care days off)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §16-5(1), (4): 5 労働日 a year (10 for two or more 対象家族 in a 要介護状態), the year from 1 April unless the employer sets another. The Act does not make it paid; recorded default: unpaid (is_npl) unless the work rules pay it. The number of family members is the terms fact care_family_members.

name: 子の看護等休暇 (child-nursing etc. leave)
authority: 育児休業、介護休業等育児又は家族介護を行う労働者の福祉に関する法律 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/403AC0000000076) §16-2(1), (4): 5 労働日 a year (10 for two or more) for a child up to the first 31 March after reaching nine (the end of grade 3), the year from 1 April unless the employer sets another. The Act does not make it paid; recorded default: unpaid (is_npl) unless the work rules pay it. Recorded default: a child under ten on the day counts — never fewer days than the Act, a child born on 1 April counted a year longer.
